CustomField.formula:
IF( AND( CONTAINS(Lender_Account__r.Name, 'National Funding'), ISPICKVAL(Actual_Payment_Frequency__c, 'Weekly')), Fund_Date_For_Actual__c + ((VALUE(ACTUAL_MCA_TERM__c) * 7) * 7/10),
IF( AND( CONTAINS(Lender_Account__r.Name, 'National Funding'), ISPICKVAL(Actual_Payment_Frequency__c, 'Daily')), Fund_Date_For_Actual__c + ((( VALUE(ACTUAL_MCA_TERM__c) /5)*7) * 7/10),
IF( AND( NOT( CONTAINS(Lender_Account__r.Name, 'National Funding')), ISPICKVAL(Actual_Payment_Frequency__c, 'Weekly')), Fund_Date_For_Actual__c + ((VALUE(ACTUAL_MCA_TERM__c) * 7) * 65/100),
IF( AND( NOT( CONTAINS(Lender_Account__r.Name, 'National Funding')), ISPICKVAL(Actual_Payment_Frequency__c, 'Daily')), Fund_Date_For_Actual__c + ((( VALUE(ACTUAL_MCA_TERM__c) /5)*7) * 65/100), NOW()))))
CustomField.label: Expected Renewal Date
